name: Mirecrown Linnorm - Venerable
description: Venerable Mirecrown is a chaotic, instinct-driven worldborn linnorm clever, wingless, non-humanoid linnorm with mud-caked scales, reed-crowned sensory spines, and a broad paddle tail. It seeks to restore blocked waterways and defend its nesting grounds. At this age it is a legendary, nearly unstoppable presence.

attacks.name: Ambush Bite
attacks.description: The linnorm strikes one target within Very Close range with its primary natural weapons.

abilities.name: Relentless (4)
abilities.description: The linnorm can be spotlighted up to 4 times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

abilities.name: Mud Camouflage
abilities.description: Before the linnorm first attacks or after it becomes Hidden in a wetland, a creature must succeed on an Instinct Roll to locate it.

abilities.name: Choking Spray
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to exhale a cone reaching Close range. All enemies in the cone make an Agility Reaction Roll against Difficulty 20. On a failure, take 4d8+10 physical damage and the target marks 1 Stress from bile and rotting peat. On a success, take half damage without the additional effect.

abilities.name: Death Roll
abilities.description: Mark a Stress. Make an attack against one creature within Melee range. On a success, deal 4d12+10 physical damage and make the target Restrained in its jaws until the target escapes with a successful Strength Roll.

abilities.name: Submerge
abilities.description: After taking damage in deep water or mud, mark a Stress to move to another point within Close range and become Hidden until it attacks or an enemy locates it with a successful Instinct Roll.

abilities.name: Reclaim the Channel
abilities.description: Spend a Fear. Send a surge of mud and water through an area within Far range. Creatures there make an Agility Reaction Roll. On a failure, they take 4d8+10 physical damage and are pulled to a visible point within Close range of the linnorm; on a success, they take half damage and remain in place.

abilities.name: Epic Ferocity
abilities.description: Once per scene, immediately after the dragon marks its fifth HP, it clears 2 Stress and may immediately move up to Close range. This movement does not grant an attack. If it has fewer than five HP, trigger this after it marks half its total HP instead.
